line_evidence.text: A2.2.1 Describe the functions and practical applications of network topologies.
• Factors to consider must include reliability, transmission speed, scalability, data collisions, cost.
• Examples may include home and small office settings, where reliability is paramount, and the use of
networks in larger settings (e.g. corporations, government departments, college campuses).
